nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the provenance hash of the NFT collection; written by setProvenanceHash.
Block number used as the seed to derive the collection starting index; set in mintNFTs and emergencySetStartingIndexBlock.
Computed pseudo-random starting index for token reveal, derived from blockhash in setStartingIndex.
Timestamp after which reveal occurs; initialized with block.timestamp + 86400 and mutable via setRevealTimestamp.
Mint price per NFT in wei; owner-settable and used in the mintNFTs payment check.
Maximum number of NFTs mintable in a single transaction; owner-settable.
Hard cap on the total NFT supply (3623) enforced during minting.
Boolean sale state flag toggled by flipSaleState and checked in mintNFTs.
Constant payable address receiving one quarter of the contract balance in withdraw.
Constant payable address receiving the remaining balance in withdraw.
Ciphersquares constructor; sets REVEAL_TIMESTAMP = block.timestamp + 86400 and initializes the ERC721 name/symbol.
Owner-only withdrawal that splits the contract balance into 1/4 and 3/4 and sends them via address.transfer to _tFirst and _tSecond.
Owner-only function that mints _numberOfTokens NFTs to _to using _safeMint inside a loop.
Owner-only setter for nftPrice.
Owner-only setter for maxNFTPurchase.
Owner-only setter for REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Owner-only setter for NFT_PROVENANCE.
Owner-only function that sets the ERC721 base URI via _setBaseURI.
Owner-only function that toggles saleIsActive.
View function enumerating all token IDs owned by _owner.
Payable public mint function; validates sale state, per-tx cap, supply cap and payment, then _safeMint in a loop to msg.sender.
Public function deriving startingIndex from blockhash(startingIndexBlock); uses a weak randomness source.
Owner-only function setting startingIndexBlock to the current block.number.
Caller-controlled address; recipient of minted NFTs and subject to onlyOwner checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for REVEAL_TIMESTAMP initialization and the reveal condition.
External ETH transfer via address.transfer to _tFirst and _tSecond inside withdraw.
_safeMint triggers the IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received external callback on the mint recipient inside a loop.
Use of blockhash and block.number as a pseudo-random source for startingIndex.
Recipient address parameter of reserveNFTs.
Number of tokens to reserve parameter of reserveNFTs.
New price parameter of setMintPrice.
New max-per-transaction parameter of setMaxToMint.
New reveal timestamp parameter of setRevealTimestamp.
New provenance hash parameter of setProvenanceHash.
New base URI parameter of setBaseURI.
Owner address parameter of tokensOfOwner.
Number of tokens to mint parameter of mintNFTs.
Local supply snapshot (totalSupply) used to seed minted token IDs in reserveNFTs.
Loop index of the reserveNFTs mint loop.
Local variable holding the contract balance in withdraw.
Local variable holding total/4 in withdraw.
Local token balance of the queried owner in tokensOfOwner.
Local array accumulating owned token IDs in tokensOfOwner.
Loop index of the tokensOfOwner enumeration loop.
Local token ID (totalSupply) selected for minting in mintNFTs.

edges.reason: _to is passed as the recipient of _safeMint in reserveNFTs.
_numberOfTokens controls the loop count of the reserveNFTs minting loop.
_price is assigned to nftPrice in setMintPrice.
_maxValue is assigned to maxNFTPurchase in setMaxToMint.
revealTimeStamp is assigned to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in setRevealTimestamp.
provenanceHash is assigned to NFT_PROVENANCE in setProvenanceHash.
baseURI is forwarded to _setBaseURI in setBaseURI.
_owner is used to enumerate owned tokens in tokensOfOwner.
numberOfTokens drives the mint loop and the nftPrice.mul payment calculation in mintNFTs.
supply (totalSupply) seeds the token IDs minted by reserveNFTs.
loop index i iterates the reserveNFTs mint loop.
total (contract balance) is read inside withdraw.
amount (total.div(4)) is computed inside withdraw.
tokenCount (balanceOf) bounds the tokensOfOwner enumeration loop.
result array is populated and returned by tokensOfOwner.
index iterates the tokensOfOwner enumeration loop.
mintIndex (totalSupply) selects the token ID minted in mintNFTs.
contract balance total flows into the externally transferred amount in withdraw.
amount flows into the external transfer operation in withdraw.
msg.sender is the recipient of _safeMint, allowing a receiver callback to re-enter during mintNFTs.
msg.sender becomes the callback target of IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received invoked by _safeMint.
block.timestamp initializes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in the constructor, creating a timestamp dependency.
the block.timestamp >= REVEAL_TIMESTAMP condition influences startingIndexBlock in mintNFTs.
withdraw is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
reserveNFTs is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
setMintPrice is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
setMaxToMint is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
setRevealTimestamp is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
setProvenanceHash is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
setBaseURI is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
flipSaleState is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
setMintPrice writes the nftPrice state variable.
setMaxToMint writes the maxNFTPurchase state variable.
setRevealTimestamp writes the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP state variable.
setProvenanceHash writes the NFT_PROVENANCE state variable.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes the startingIndexBlock state variable.
setStartingIndex writes the startingIndex state variable.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive the starting index.
mintNFTs conditionally writes startingIndexBlock when reveal conditions are met.
mintNFTs reads saleIsActive to gate minting.
mintNFTs enforces the MAX_NFT supply cap.
mintNFTs reads nftPrice for the payment validation.
mintNFTs enforces the maxNFTPurchase per-transaction limit.
withdraw transfers a quarter of the balance to the _tFirst address.
withdraw transfers the remaining balance to the _tSecond address.
the constructor writes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP using block.timestamp, introducing timestamp dependence.
withdraw invokes the external ETH transfer unsafe operation.
reserveNFTs calls _safeMint which invokes the receiver callback unsafe operation.
mintNFTs calls _safeMint inside a loop, invoking receiver callbacks.
setStartingIndex relies on the blockhash pseudo-random unsafe operation.
_safeMint calls onERC721Received on the msg.sender recipient contract, a reentrancy callback path.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a parameter used only within the reserveNFTs mint flow and can be folded into that function.
_numberOfTokens only parameterizes the reserveNFTs loop and can be folded into that function.
_price feeds directly into the nftPrice assignment in setMintPrice.
_maxValue feeds directly into the maxNFTPurchase assignment in setMaxToMint.
revealTimeStamp feeds directly into the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP assignment in setRevealTimestamp.
provenanceHash feeds directly into the NFT_PROVENANCE assignment in setProvenanceHash.
baseURI feeds directly into the _setBaseURI call in setBaseURI.
_owner is the sole input consumed by tokensOfOwner.
numberOfTokens is the sole input driving the mintNFTs minting and payment logic.
supply is a local snapshot consumed only inside reserveNFTs.
i is a loop-local index consumed only inside reserveNFTs.
total is a local balance variable consumed only inside withdraw.
amount is a local share value consumed only inside withdraw.
tokenCount is a loop bound local used only inside tokensOfOwner.
result is the return-array local used only inside tokensOfOwner.
index is a loop-local counter used only inside tokensOfOwner.
mintIndex is a loop-local token ID used only inside mintNFTs.
